You almost killed a person. Well, what are you gonna do?
Missed!
Next time, maybe you should try aiming, just a theory.
That animal ain't on your license. Good thing you lacked the skill needed to actually hit it. .
I'm not going to say that was the worst shot I've ever seen, mostly because you're armed.
That gun is too small to bring down that animal. Unless you plan to use it like a club. Now that will be impressive.
source: Johnny Hardwick · King of the Hill (Windows, 2000)
